# Google Gemini Enterprise / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — captured 2026-08-10

# (B) renders nav-only via WebFetch; recovered via WebSearch.

## Stream A — Gemini Enterprise release notes (dated entries) — NEWEST STILL AUGUST 7
### August 7, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09)
- Custom MCP server data stores reach GA. Organizations can connect their own MCP server to Gemini
  Enterprise to securely access private company data. Turned OFF by default; requires administrator
  approval (org policy constraint, with a documented override path).
  docs/connectors/custom-mcp-server/set-up-custom-mcp-server
  Auth: none or OAuth 2.0. Endpoint must be HTTPS using StreamableHTTP transport.
  MCP servers can also be imported from the Agent Registry.

### August 6, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09)
- The description field was removed from custom MCP server data store setup. Gemini Enterprise now
  calls the server's `tools/list` endpoint automatically to discover tools, parameter schemas and
  capabilities, and routes on the explicit tool definitions.
- Gemini 3.5 Flash removal from the global region postponed. [deprecation — not reported]

### August 4, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09)
- Two new trace spans for data connectors: `execute_tool` (agent orchestration layer) and
  `invoke_connector` (connector execution layer), giving end-to-end parent-child workflows from the
  assistant prompt through to the third-party API.

### August 3, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09)
- 17 new connectors in public preview: Attio, Cohesity, Descript, Fiscal.ai, Gamma, iManage,
  Moody's, NetDocuments, Nexla, Oracle NetSuite, Pylon, S&P Global, Sanity, Supabase, Supermetrics,
  SurveyMonkey, Wix.
- New action: Freshservice "create ticket note".

### August 1, 2026
- Pay-as-you-go edition GA. [billing model — not reported]

## Stream B — Agent Platform release notes (recovered via WebSearch)
- Grok 4.1 family deprecated, shutdown August 20, 2026; migrate to Grok 4.2/4.3 or Model Garden
  alternatives. [deprecation]
- Nano Banana preview image models retired. [deprecation]
- **SSRF vulnerability fixed** in the auto-generated `/api-proxy` backend endpoint for web
  applications created before July 1, 2026 using **Agent Studio**. Affected users must regenerate
  the app from Agent Studio and redeploy.
  [VULNERABILITY FIX, not a new capability — held below the reporting bar. But worth recording that
  Agent Studio auto-generates an `/api-proxy` backend endpoint per web app: that is an
  agent-adjacent network surface Zenity does not currently inventory, and a candidate AIRT target.]
- No net-new Agent Platform capability since the AlphaEvolve GA / Memory Profiles GA / Feedback
  service items reported 2026-08-07.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change. Stream A newest dated entry is still August 7, 2026; no Aug 8/9/10
entries on either stream. Neither canonical URL is in sources.json (outstanding since 2026-07-08).
